messages.content:
「假設你是一位科學家，正在研究某種細菌的能量產生。你有一個這種細菌的樣本，它已經消耗了5莫耳葡萄糖（C6H12O6），你知道葡萄糖產生的能量通常是每莫耳2800千焦耳。你也知道這種細菌的轉換效率，即從葡萄糖轉換為生物量的能量百分比，為10%。

首先，計算細菌從消耗葡萄糖產生的總能量。

其次，根據產生的能量和轉換效率，計算細菌產生的生物量。

現在，假設你正在使用這種細菌在生物反應器中驅動一台小型機器。這台機器需要移動2公尺的距離，你想計算機器所做的功。

第三，根據細菌產生的總能量和機器需要移動的距離，計算機器所做的功。」

function.name: biological_calc_biomass
function.description: Calculate the biomass from the energy given the energy conversion efficiency. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

energy.description: The total energy produced. This is a float type value.

efficiency.description: The conversion efficiency, default value is 10%. This is a float type value.

function.name: biological_calc_energy
function.description: Calculate energy from amount of substance based on its molecular composition. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

mols.description: Amount of substance in moles. This is a float type value.

substance.description: The chemical formula of the substance.

joules_per_mol.description: The energy produced or required for the reaction, default value for glucose is 2800 kJ/mol This is a float type value.

function.name: physical_calc_work
function.description: Calculate the work from energy. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

energy.description: The total energy produced. This is a float type value.

distance.description: The distance over which the work is done. This is a float type value.
